generatedProse.concept-context: In psychology, this means bringing the three ideas to every search, whatever the topic. You decide what you are looking for, perhaps recent studies on memory, choose keywords such as 'sleep', 'memory' and 'recall', then search and weigh what comes back. A search on a therapy and a search on an experiment use the same practice. Making this your normal way of searching is what steadily improves the sources you find in psychology.
generatedProse.worked-example: Two psychology students each need sources for an essay on memory. Tom types the whole essay question into a search box and uses the first article, with no plan and no second look. Amara uses the whole practice instead: she sets an objective, picks keywords with a synonym, searches, then weighs which studies are suitable. Both knew the topic, but Amara found clearer, more trustworthy sources, because her search used every part of the practice.
generatedProse.summary: Academic searching in psychology is most useful when you treat it as one practice, not three separate ideas. You bring the same moves to every search: know what you are looking for, plan, choose keywords, then search and weigh what you find. Making this your normal way of searching is what steadily improves the sources behind your psychology work.

check.body: A student decides what they are looking for, chooses keywords with a synonym, searches, and weighs the sources before using them. What does this show?

items.text: Their next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved.
Nothing; feedback comes at the end, so it cannot affect anything that follows.

feedback.correct: That's right. Using the feedback fed back into the next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved: that is the cycle working.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. Think about what the student changed before the next report, not the old mark or the deadline.
feedback.incorrectFinal: Using the feedback fed back into the student's next round of learning and preparation, which is why the next report improved. The old mark cannot change and the deadline is not part of the cycle; feedback is not the end, it feeds the next turn.

_items.text: That they are using the whole searching practice: the three ideas working together, from deciding what they want to weighing what they find.
_items.feedback: Yes. Every idea is there, working together as one practice.

_items.text: That they are doing more than any search really needs.
_items.feedback: No. Each part does a different job, and together they make the search stronger.

_items.text: That only the keywords really matter in a search.
_items.feedback: Not so. Keywords are one part of the practice, not the whole of it.

_items.text: That weighing the sources is the same as planning the search.
_items.feedback: They are different parts: planning comes first, and weighing the sources comes later.
